I now have a complete picture of the entire file. Here is the full structural report: --- ## CareerSettings.tsx — Full Structure Report ### Layout The page is a single long-scroll layout. There are NO tabs. Everything lives inside a `
` wrapper with `
` stacking 9 cards vertically. Each section has its own "Save changes" button — there is no single global save at the bottom. --- ### Header - Page title: "Career Page" (h1) - Subtitle: "Customize your public career page and manage which jobs are visible to candidates." - When the page is active (`isActive === true`) AND a slug is set, a "Live" badge + Copy URL icon + Open in new tab icon appear in the top-right corner. --- ### Card 1: Career Page Configuration Icon: Globe Fields: 1. **Company name** — `Input`, plain text, auto-generates the slug as you type (if slug hasn't been manually edited) 2. **URL slug** — Custom input with `/careers/` prefix displayed inline. Lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens only, max 60 chars. Has a `SlugStatusBadge` (idle / checking / available / taken) with debounced RPC check (`is_career_slug_available`) 3. **Logo URL** — `Input`, type=url 4. **Brand color** — Color picker (``) + hex `Input` side-by-side, validates 6-digit hex (#rrggbb), default `#6366f1`. Shows error message if invalid hex 5. **Tagline** — `Input`, max 160 chars 6. **About** — `Textarea`, 4 rows, resize-none, max 2000 chars 7. **Publish career page** — `Switch` toggle in a bordered row, with label and helper text "Make your career page publicly accessible to candidates." 8. **Preview link row** — Appears only when `isActive === true` and slug is set. Shows the full URL (`/careers/:slug`) with inline copy and open-in-new-tab buttons. 9. **Save changes** button (right-aligned, disabled if saving or slug is "taken") --- ### Card 2: Cover Image Icon: Globe Fields: 1. **Cover image URL** — `Input`, type=url, placeholder shows example 2. **Inline preview** — If URL is filled, renders `` with an `onError` fallback to hide the image 3. **Save** button (small, right-aligned) --- ### Card 3: Culture & Benefits Icon: Star Fields: 1. **Section title** — `Input`, default "Why Join Us", max 80 chars 2. **Description** — `Textarea`, 4 rows, resize-none, max 2000 chars, live character counter (`X/2000`) 3. **Benefits list** — Dynamic list (max 12 benefits), each benefit is a bordered card (`bg-muted/20`) with: - **Lucide icon name** — `Input` (e.g. "Heart", "Zap", "Globe") — mapped to emoji fallbacks for rendering - **Title** — `Input`, max 60 chars - **Description** — `Input`, max 160 chars - Remove button (Trash2 icon, top-right of each card) - "Add benefit" button (disabled when 12 benefits reached) - Empty state: dashed border placeholder when no benefits 4. **Save changes** button (right-aligned) --- ### Card 4: Social Links Icon: Link2 Five URL fields, each with an icon prefix and a label suffix on the right: 1. **Website** — Globe icon, placeholder `https://yourcompany.com` 2. **LinkedIn** — Linkedin icon, placeholder `https://linkedin.com/company/...` 3. **X / Twitter** — Twitter icon, placeholder `https://x.com/...` 4. **Instagram** — Instagram icon, placeholder `https://instagram.com/...` 5. **Facebook** — Facebook icon, placeholder `https://facebook.com/...` All are `type="url"` inputs. Save changes button (right-aligned). --- ### Card 5: SEO Icon: Globe Fields: 1. **Meta description** — `Textarea`, 3 rows, max 160 chars, character counter changes to amber at >155 chars 2. **Meta keywords** — `Input`, comma-separated, helper text "Comma-separated keywords." 3. **Save changes** button (right-aligned) --- ### Card 6: Custom CSS Icon: Code2 Features: - Warning banner (yellow, Info icon): "Custom CSS is injected directly into your career page. Incorrect styles may break the page layout." - **CSS textarea** — 8 rows, `font-mono text-xs`, max 5000 chars, character counter turns amber at >4800 chars, placeholder shows example `.career-hero` and `.job-card` styles - **Save changes** button (right-aligned) Note: There is NO `font_family` field in the UI despite it being in the `CareerPageConfig` TypeScript interface. Font family was never wired up to a form field. --- ### Card 7: Email Subscribers Icon: Users Read-only display: - Stat box showing subscriber count (large bold number) with label "subscriber(s) waiting for new job alerts" - Data fetched via `career_subscribers` table with `count: exact` - No actions, no export button --- ### Card 8: Published Jobs Icon: Globe Table with columns: - **Title** — with optional "Featured" badge (Star icon) and employment type sub-line - **Location** — hidden on mobile (`hidden sm:table-cell`) - **Expires** — hidden below md, shows "Expired" in destructive color if past date - **Analytics** — hidden below lg, shows `X views · Y applied` - **Published toggle** — `Switch` per row, with loading spinner (`Loader2`) when toggling; calls `toggleJobPublished` mutation Empty state: Centered illustration with "No jobs yet" message. Loading state: `JobsSkeleton` (3 placeholder rows). --- ### Card 9: Custom Domain (Coming Soon) Icon: Link2 + "Coming soon" Badge Read-only marketing/feature preview card. Lists 5 planned features as a checklist (CheckCircle2 icons): 1. Point any subdomain or root domain to Rankora via CNAME 2. Automatic SSL certificate provisioning 3. Branded URL in all candidate-facing email links 4. No Rankora branding on custom domain pages 5. Domain verification dashboard with DNS health check "Request Early Access" button — triggers a `toast.success` notification (no actual submission). --- ### CareerPage.tsx (Public Page) — First 100 Lines The public page (`/careers/:slug`) consumes all the config fields set in CareerSettings. Its `CareerConfig` interface mirrors everything: `company_name`, `logo_url`, `brand_color`, `tagline`, `about`, `custom_css`, `cover_image_url`, `culture_title`, `culture_description`, `benefits[]`, `social_links`, `meta_description`, `meta_keywords`. It also defines a `SubscribeSection` component using the `career_subscribers` table. The public page uses `useParams` to get the slug, queries Supabase for the config and published jobs, and renders accordingly. --- ### Tabs Component Usage The shadcn `Tabs` component (`@/components/ui/tabs`) is already used in the project in these files: - `/src/pages/Integrations.tsx` - `/src/pages/AgencyHub.tsx` - `/src/components/AuthForm.tsx` - `/src/components/admin/AIPromptsTab.tsx` - `/src/components/admin/PlatformSettingsTab.tsx` - `/src/components/admin/SeoTab.tsx` - `/src/components/admin/BillingTab.tsx` - `/src/components/admin/UsersTab.tsx` - `/src/components/admin/EmailSettingsTab.tsx` The component itself lives at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/components/ui/tabs.tsx` (built on `@radix-ui/react-tabs`). All four exports — `Tabs`, `TabsContent`, `TabsList`, `TabsTrigger` — are available and battle-tested throughout the app. --- ### Key Observations for a Tab Refactor - All 9 cards could naturally collapse into ~4-5 tabs: e.g. **General** (Cards 1+2), **Culture** (Card 3), **Links & SEO** (Cards 4+5), **Advanced** (Card 6), **Jobs & Subscribers** (Cards 7+8), **Domain** (Card 9) - Each card currently has its own Save button; a tab layout would let you either keep per-tab saves or consolidate to one - The `font_family` field exists in the DB interface but has no UI — a refactor would be a good time to add a font picker - No preview panel exists — the only "preview" is the live URL link when the page is active
